ios.desc:
MineField is a free Minesweeper game rules in Reliable, Smoothest, and Fast with a Universal game run on every your iOS devices.
Beautiful themes from Classic to a few clear Material Design interface:  Bright, Sepia, Night, or you can choose your favor color.

We will keep our best to improve this game, since we are also devotees of Minesweeper!
Please support to give a review or bug report by mail.

----------------------------------------------
Features
----------------------------------------------
• Easy to control (Field can scroll & zoom, Normal and flag mode, Quick open, etc.)
• A few beautiful themes: Classic, Bright, Sepia, Night
• Three levels: Easy, Medium, Advance
• Reliable & fast launch time
• First tap luck option (turn off to 100% randomly mine locations)
• Auto save game 
• High score/Statistics data
• GameCenter leaderboard support
• Retina resolution support on every iOS devices
• Build in minesweeper help

----------------------------------------------
Game Control
----------------------------------------------
• Tap a square to clear it
• Tap and hold to place a Flag mark
• Tap and hold to clear Flag or Question mark
• Tap to switch between Flag and Question mark
• Double tap a numbered square to quick open its neighbor squares [Quick open]
• Double tap empty square or Tap Flag icon to toggle between Quick Flagging and Normal mode

----------------------------------------------
Minefield Support
----------------------------------------------
Please like and follow our Facebook Page to get update from Minefield
 • Want to be featured on our Page? post with tag #bestOfMinefield
 • Facebook: facebook.com/minefieldminesweeper
 • Email: theboostapp@gmail.com
